transforms.code:
#The tools that can be mounted here from this screen: not mounted anywhere, in this machine's site (or outside any
	#site), and with an enabled Fits On rule that allows this machine, its asset type, or a tool mounted on it (to go in
	#its pockets). A tool with no rules isn't offered here; a machine's Tooling tags can still mount it
	asset = value['asset']
	assetId = asset.get('assetId') if asset else None
	if assetId is None: return []
	tools = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.tooling.getTools({'enabled': True, 'mountableOn': assetId}) or []) or []
	typeOf = dict((r['toolingAssetId'], r['assetTypeId']) for r in tools)
	mountedIds = set()
	for m in (value['mounted'] or []):
		try: mountedIds.add(m['toolingAssetId'])
		except: pass
	mountedTypes = set(typeOf[i] for i in mountedIds if typeOf.get(i) is not None)
	machineType = asset.get('assetTypeId')

	def allows(rule):
		if rule['parentAssetId'] is not None: return rule['parentAssetId'] == assetId
		if rule['parentToolingAssetId'] is not None: return rule['parentToolingAssetId'] in mountedIds
		return rule['parentAssetTypeId'] is not None and (rule['parentAssetTypeId'] == machineType or rule['parentAssetTypeId'] in mountedTypes)

	fitTools, fitTypes = set(), set()
	for rule in system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.tooling.getCompatibilityRules({'enabled': True}) or []) or []:
		if not allows(rule): continue
		if rule['childToolingAssetId'] is not None: fitTools.add(rule['childToolingAssetId'])
		elif rule['childAssetTypeId'] is not None: fitTypes.add(rule['childAssetTypeId'])
	return [{'value': r['toolingAssetId'], 'label': r['assetName']} for r in tools
			if not r['isMounted'] and (r['toolingAssetId'] in fitTools or r['assetTypeId'] in fitTypes)]

#Say why the list is empty: only tools with a Fits On rule for this machine are offered
	return 'A tool that is not mounted' if len(value or []) > 0 else 'No unmounted tool fits this machine (see the Fits On tab in Tooling)'

config.script:
info = dict(self.view.custom.mountInfo)
	if info['toolingAssetId'] is None:
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'warning', 'message': 'Pick a tool to mount'})
		return
	start = info['startDate']
	if start is not None and system.date.isBefore(start, self.view.custom.shiftStart):
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'warning', 'message': 'A mount can only go back to the start of this shift'})
		return
	mountInfo = {'toolingAssetId': info['toolingAssetId'], 'startDate': start}
	target = info['target'] or ''
	if target:
		parentId, positionId = target.split(':')
		mountInfo['parentToolingAssetId'] = int(parentId)
		mountInfo['parentPositionId'] = int(positionId)
	else:
		mountInfo['assetId'] = self.view.custom.asset['assetId']
	#A tool with output positions replaces the machine's (868mvuy7u): the gateway unmounts it at the same moment, in the
	#same transaction, so a refused mount leaves it mounted
	mountInfo['replaceOutputTool'] = True
	#Every check first, writing nothing, so a mount that would be refused doesn't put the machine into Changeover
	root = self.view.rootContainer
	replaced, msg = system.kanoa.tooling.mount(dict(mountInfo, validateOnly=True), self.view.custom.security.userId)
	if msg and not msg.startswith('Needs confirmation:'):
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'error', 'message': "Couldn't mount %s: %s" % (root.toolName(info['toolingAssetId']), msg)})
		return
	name = root.toolName(info['toolingAssetId'])
	if replaced:
		mountInfo['replacesName'] = root.toolName(replaced)
	what = ('Replace %s with %s' % (mountInfo['replacesName'], name)) if replaced else ('Mount %s' % name)
	if msg:
		#Warnings are confirmed before the changeover question, so cancelling them leaves the machine as it was
		root.confirmMountWarnings(mountInfo, msg, what)
		return
	if start is not None:
		root.mountTool(mountInfo)
		return
	root.askChangeover('mount', mountInfo, what, 'Replace only' if replaced else 'Mount only')
	return

customMethods.script:
# A warning (a tool over a limit, or the site's tooling check) comes back as "Needs confirmation: ..."; accepting it
	# mounts again with acceptWarnings, and the mount records what was accepted
	# changeoverAsset: the asset the Changeover prompt just set to Changeover, named in this toast (not passed to mount)
	changed = mountInfo.pop('changeoverAsset', None)
	note = ('; %s set to Changeover' % changed) if changed else ''
	assignmentId, msg = system.kanoa.tooling.mount(mountInfo, self.view.custom.security.userId)
	if msg and msg.startswith('Needs confirmation:') and not mountInfo.get('acceptWarnings'):
		if changed: mountInfo['changeoverAsset'] = changed
		self.confirmMountWarnings(mountInfo, msg, None)
		return
	if msg:
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'error', 'message': msg + ((' (%s is in Changeover)' % changed) if changed else '')})
		return
	if mountInfo.get('replacesName'): system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'success', 'message': '%s mounted, replacing %s%s' % (self.toolName(mountInfo['toolingAssetId']), mountInfo['replacesName'], note)})
	else: system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'success', 'message': 'Tool mounted' + note})
	self.view.custom.mountInfo = {'toolingAssetId': None, 'target': '', 'startDate': None}
	self.view.custom.refresh = system.date.now()
	system.perspective.sendMessage('toolingChanged', {})
	return

customMethods.script:
# A tool change is changeover, not production: offer to put the machine into its Changeover mode first, unless it's
	# already in it or has no Changeover mode
	asset = self.view.custom.asset
	modeName = None
	try:
		modeName = system.tag.readBlocking(['[kanoaMES]' + asset['assetPath'].replace('\\', '/') + '/OEE/Status/modeName'])[0].value
	except:
		pass
	modes = system.kanoa.asset.getAssetModes({'assetId': asset['assetId'], 'modeName': 'Changeover', 'enabled': True})
	if modeName == 'Changeover' or modes is None or modes.getRowCount() == 0:
		self.runAction(action, payload)
		return
	payload = dict(payload)
	if payload.get('startDate') is not None:
		payload['startDate'] = system.date.toMillis(payload['startDate'])
	text = '%s. Put %s into Changeover first? It is in %s.' % (what, asset['assetName'], modeName or 'no mode')
	system.perspective.openPopup('toolingChangeover', 'kanoa/mes/asset/operation/tooling/changeoverPrompt',
		{'text': text, 'continueText': continueText, 'payload': {'action': action, 'info': payload}},
		title='Changeover', modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)
	return

customMethods.name: setChangeover
customMethods.script:
# The same mode change as the Run Control's Mode tab: no item or order, from the operator. No toast when it works: the
	# mount's or unmount's own toast says it, so there's one toast, not two
	asset = self.view.custom.asset
	modeCode = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('modeCode', system.kanoa.asset.getAssetModes({'assetId': asset['assetId'], 'modeName': 'Changeover', 'enabled': True}))
	info = {'assetId': asset['assetId'], 'modeCode': modeCode, 'workOrderId': None, 'itemId': None, 'standardRate': None,
			'modeSourceId': system.kanoa.asset.getModeSourceId('Operator'), 'tStamp': system.date.now(), 'includeChildren': True}
	modeEventId, msg = system.kanoa.event.assetOperationChange(info, self.view.custom.security.userId)
	if msg or modeEventId is None:
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'warning', 'message': 'Could not set %s to Changeover. %s' % (asset['assetName'], msg or '')})
		return False
	return True

	#goes ahead. what: the action's text, to ask about Changeover after (None: mount straight away)
	payload = dict(mountInfo)
	if payload.get('startDate') is not None:
		payload['startDate'] = system.date.toMillis(payload['startDate'])
	payload['what'] = what
	text = msg[len('Needs confirmation:'):].strip().replace(' | ', '. ') + '. Mount anyway?'
	system.perspective.openPopup('toolingMountConfirm', 'kanoa/core/templates/inputs/confirm',
		{'text': text, 'messageHandler': 'toolingMountConfirm', 'inputPayload': payload},
		title='Mount warnings', modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)

messageHandlers.script:
if payload['userInput'] != 'OK':
		return
	mountInfo = dict(payload['inputPayload'])
	if mountInfo.get('startDate') is not None:
		mountInfo['startDate'] = system.date.fromMillis(long(mountInfo['startDate']))
	mountInfo['acceptWarnings'] = True
	what = mountInfo.pop('what', None)
	#From the Mount button (what given, no start date): ask about Changeover now the warnings are accepted
	if what and mountInfo.get('startDate') is None:
		self.askChangeover('mount', mountInfo, what, 'Replace only' if mountInfo.get('replacesName') else 'Mount only')
		return
	self.mountTool(mountInfo)
	return

# From the changeoverPrompt popup: 'changeover' sets the mode first (and stops if that fails), 'continue' doesn't
	if payload['choice'] == 'changeover' and not self.setChangeover():
		return
	action = payload['payload']['action']
	info = dict(payload['payload']['info'])
	if info.get('startDate') is not None:
		info['startDate'] = system.date.fromMillis(long(info['startDate']))
	if payload['choice'] == 'changeover':
		info['changeoverAsset'] = self.view.custom.asset['assetName']
	self.runAction(action, info)
	return
